gorev.cop_kutusu_temizligi: Deletion of expired recycle bin items
gorev.seo_taramasi: Technical SEO and speed scan (3 sites per run)
gorev.google_esitleme: Google data sync (Analytics, Search Console, YouTube)
gorev.crm_bildirimleri: CRM: new lead notifications from price quotes
gorev.teklif_ve_sozlesme: Quote expiry and contract end reminders
gorev.webhook_temizligi: Cleanup of old webhook logs (30 days)
gorev.randevu_hatirlatmalari: Appointment reminders (24 hours and 1 hour before)
gorev.otomasyon: Automation rules (queued, after "wait"; overdue invoice, unanswered quote, inactive lead events)
gorev.otomasyon_temizligi: Cleanup of old automation run logs (30 days)
gorev.ai_asistan_bakimi: AI assistant: weekly site refresh and conversation retention clean-up
gorev.icerik_studyosu: Content studio: sharing reminder (30 min before) and publish-time event
gorev.eposta_pazarlama: Email marketing sends (scheduled campaigns, A/B decision, drip sequences)
gorev.saha_servisi: Field service: maintenance reminders, location and retention cleanup
gorev.etkinlik_bakimi: Event maintenance (payment holds, waiting-list invitations, thank-you email)
gorev.saklama_temizligi: Retention cleanup of old visit and click records (13 months)

ne.uptime: Checks client sites every few minutes; if a site is down it tells you (and the client), and again when it is back.
ne.imzali_islem_sureleri: Closes expired approval links (quote, contract, content approval) so they can no longer be used.
ne.sla_kontrolu: Watches support response times; tells you when a deadline is close and when it is missed.
ne.belge_hatirlatmalari: Reminds the client 2 days before a requested document is due; tells you both once the date has passed.
ne.aylik_rapor_taslaklari: In the first days of each month, prepares last month's report draft for clients; it is sent when you approve.
ne.bitis_taramasi: Automatically checks and records domain and SSL certificate expiry dates.
ne.yenileme_hatirlatmalari: Reminds you (and the client, if enabled) 30, 15, 7 and 1 days before domain, SSL, hosting or subscription expiry.
ne.kredi_sure_dolumlari: Deducts the remainder of expired client credits from the balance.
ne.uptime_temizligi: Cleans up old site availability measurements so the database does not grow.
ne.analiz_temizligi: Cleans up old site analysis records once a week.
ne.oturum_temizligi: Deletes closed session records older than 30 days.
ne.cop_kutusu_temizligi: Permanently deletes items whose retention in the trash has ended.
ne.mesaj_bildirimleri: If a panel chat message stays unread for more than a few minutes, notifies the other side (at most once every 30 minutes).
ne.seo_taramasi: Regularly measures the technical SEO and speed score of client sites; tells you if the score drops.
ne.google_esitleme: Pulls the latest figures from connected Google accounts (Analytics, Search Console, YouTube).
ne.crm_bildirimleri: Notifies you about new leads coming from the pricing wizard.
ne.crm_hatirlatma: Every day, reminds you in one summary notification of CRM leads whose next-step date has arrived.
ne.tekrarlayan_faturalar: Issues invoices for subscriptions and recurring services automatically when the period comes (once per period).
ne.fatura_hatirlatmalari: For overdue invoices, sends the client payment reminders on days 1, 7 and 14 and keeps you informed.
ne.teklif_ve_sozlesme: Marks quotes past their validity date as "expired"; reminds you 30 and 7 days before a contract ends.
ne.webhook_teslimatlari: Retries events that could not be delivered to other systems (webhook) at growing intervals for 3 days.
ne.webhook_temizligi: Deletes webhook delivery records older than 30 days.
ne.randevu_hatirlatmalari: Emails people with appointments a reminder 24 hours and 1 hour before.
ne.otomasyon: Runs the automation rules you set up; also creates time-based events such as "invoice overdue", "quote unanswered" and "lead inactive".
ne.otomasyon_temizligi: Deletes automation run records older than 30 days.
ne.ai_asistan_bakimi: Refreshes the AI assistant's source pages once a week and deletes chats past their retention period.
ne.icerik_studyosu: Sends the owner a "ready to publish" reminder 30 minutes before a scheduled post.
ne.eposta_pazarlama: Sends email campaigns and drip steps when they are due and decides A/B tests.
ne.saha_servisi: Reports devices due for maintenance; clears old location and personal data when its time is up.
ne.etkinlik_bakimi: Releases unpaid ticket holds, invites the waiting list when seats free up and sends a thank-you email after the event.
ne.haftalik_ozet: Every Monday morning sends you a summary of what needs attention this week (nothing is sent if all is zero).
ne.aylik_site_analizi: Runs an automatic site analysis for client sites every month (at most one site per run).
ne.saklama_temizligi: Keeps QR scan, digital business card, review page, QR menu and booking page visit records and email campaign clicks for 13 months; before deleting older ones it rolls them up into daily totals, so the totals in the panel stay the same. It also deletes expired request-limit counters. Runs once a day.
ne.egitim_bakimi: Courses maintenance (class reminders, absence warnings, automatic certificates, anonymising student data past its retention period)
ne.hukuk_bakimi: Law office maintenance (hearing and deadline reminders: 7/3/1 days before and on the morning of the day, each sent once; permanent removal of clients and matters deleted more than 30 days ago)
ne.muhasebe_bakimi: Bookkeeping maintenance (due recurring entries, automatic imports and suggestions awaiting approval, budget overrun and overdue receivable events)
ne.ortaklik_bakimi: Affiliate maintenance (approves commissions whose refund window has ended; every 6 hours and whenever a partner dashboard opens)
